usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank, euro reference exchange rate (USD)
usdRate.note: USD 1.1172 per EUR, so EUR 0.8951 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI 5.26% in October 2026 (4.69% in September); EU HICP 5.2%. Secondary source because statbel.fgov.be served a bot check. Eurostat HICP for September 2026 was 4.5%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% target; Belgian CPI 5.26% (Oct 2026); HICP 12-month average 3.0% (Sep 2026, Eurostat)
inflation_projection.note: Belgium shares the ECB's credible 2% target but automatic wage indexation keeps its inflation above the euro-area average, so 2.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, deposit facility rate
policy_rate.note: ECB held rates on 29 October 2026: deposit facility 2.50%, main refinancing 2.65% (read via the ECB data API, series FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Belgian bank rates on household deposits redeemable at notice up to 3 months (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Regulated savings accounts (base rate plus loyalty premium) are reported in this category; 0.72% in August 2026. Ordinary overnight (current) accounts pay 0.06%. Read via the ECB data API.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Belgian bank rates on household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_3m_rate.note: No separate 3-month series is published; the up-to-1-year bucket (2.14% in August 2026) is used. Read via the ECB data API.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Belgian bank rates on household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: 2.14% in August 2026; 1-2 years 2.92%, over 2 years 2.97%. Read via the ECB data API.

dps_rate.note: Belgian banks do not offer a fixed-rate monthly recurring deposit (DPS-style) product; regular saving goes into regulated savings accounts or fund savings plans.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Belgian series and no all-deposit weighted average was found; the ECB MIR series give 0.06% (overnight), 0.72% (savings) and 2.14% (term up to 1 year) for August 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The Belgian Debt Agency's products for individuals currently list only OLOs and Treasury Certificates; no State Note (Staatsbon) issue with a current rate was found.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Belgium 3-month treasury certificate yield
tbill_91d_rate.note: About 2.60% (the page also shows 2.64%); secondary source because the Debt Agency's auction statistics were not readable.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No Belgian 5-year OLO yield was found on readable pages (Trading Economics shows 2-year 3.31% and 10-year 4.38% on 30 October 2026; worldgovernmentbonds.com did not load data).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Belgium 10-year government bond (OLO) yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: ECB long-term convergence rate for Belgium was 4.12% in September 2026 (IRS.M.BE.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Belgium income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: 30% withholding tax on interest (term deposits, bonds). Regulated savings accounts: first EUR 1,050 a year per person exempt (income year 2025), then 15%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Belgium income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Government bond and treasury certificate interest falls under the general 30% withholding tax on movable income (the September 2023 one-year State Note was a one-off at 15%).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank under the EU directive, paid by the Belgian Guarantee Fund for Financial Services.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Belgian bank rates on revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: 5.00% in August 2026, an average that includes overdrafts; Belgian law sets maximum annual rates for credit openings (FPS Economy), which could not be read (bot check). Card credit itself usually costs more.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BEL 20 index 5,841 on 30 Oct 2026 (base 1,000 in 1991), up 19% in a year
equity_return_low.note: Low case near the after-tax 10-year OLO yield (about 3.1%), for a decade of weak European stock returns.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 3-month treasury certificate 2.6% less 30% tax = 1.8%; BEL 20 price index about 5% a year since 1991
equity_return_base.note: After-tax safe rate of 1.8% plus a 3.7-point premium, kept under the 4-point limit; dividends (taxed at 30%) add to the BEL 20's roughly 5% a year price gain.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BEL 20 long-run record (1,000 in 1991 to 5,841 in Oct 2026) plus dividends
equity_return_high.note: High case near the BEL 20's long-run total return of about 8% a year.

gold_return_low.sourceName: ECB reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stronger euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: ECB reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no expected trend in the euro against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: ECB reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker euro.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR: savings 0.72% (tax-free to EUR 1,050), term deposits up to 1 year 2.14% less 30%
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: a mix of regulated savings and short term deposits after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 3-month treasury certificate 2.6% and 1-year term deposit 2.14%, less 30% withholding
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: short treasury certificates and term deposits after 30% withholding tax (about 1.5-1.8%), with some longer deposits.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in long OLOs after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Neither the FSMA, the NBB nor Assuralia publishes an industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that we could find.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (temporary death cover, 'schuldsaldoverzekering' and 'tijdelijke overlijdensverzekering') is widely sold, but no published per-1,000 premium table by age was found; insurers quote individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost for one major private hospital stay was found; the patient's share depends on room type and supplements, and statutory health insurance pays most of the bill.

health_premium_table.note: Belgian hospitalisation insurance is priced per plan (room type, age) rather than per sum insured, and no age-banded premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat HICP health: 3.6% a year to Sep 2026, 12-month average 3.1%
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical prices have run about a point above headline inflation, so 3.5% is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat HICP education: 2.2% a year to Sep 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: Education is mostly publicly funded and its prices track headline inflation, so the 2.5% projection plus half a point for private fees is used.

life_expectancy.note: Men 80.3, women 84.4; UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 82.6 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 33.1 (2025, World Bank), 43.4 (2040) and 50.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/belgium/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Federal Pension Service, How is the retirement date calculated?
retirement_age_default.note: Statutory age is 66 for people born 1960-1963 (reached in 2026) and 67 for those born from 1964; same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Federal Pension Service, How is the retirement date calculated?
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants' service ends automatically at the same statutory age (66 now, 67 for those born from 1964); magistrates and soldiers have their own limits.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR: regulated savings 0.72%, term deposits up to 1 year 2.14% less 30%
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings accounts and short deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of OLOs and longer deposits after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax safe rate about 1.8%; BEL 20 index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: After-tax safe rate about 1.8%; equity base 5.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half fixed income at about 2.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Federal Pension Service, Guaranteed Income for Elderly Persons (GIEP/IGO/GRAPA)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Gross EUR 1,644.28 a month for a single person (increased basic amount) and EUR 1,096.18 for a cohabitant, at index 186.83 from 1 September 2026; means-tested top-up.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Federal Pension Service, Guaranteed Income for Elderly Persons
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: From the statutory retirement age (66 in 2026, rising to 67), subject to a means test covering the household's income and assets.

gratuity_rule.note: Belgian law has no statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees; departing employees get notice or pay in lieu of notice.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Federal Pension Service, How is the retirement date calculated?
public_pension_scheme.note: Earnings-related statutory pension from social security contributions, payable from 66 (67 for those born from 1964); pensions follow the health index and are taxable. A pension reform agreed by the government is still being legislated.

savings_account.note: Base rate plus loyalty premium; interest tax-free up to EUR 1,050 a year per person.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product; regular saving goes into savings accounts or fund savings plans.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: State Notes were sold to individuals from time to time (2023-2025), but none is listed among the Debt Agency's current products for individuals.

tbill_91d.note: 3, 6 and 12 months; individuals buy them on the secondary market through a bank.

equity_fund.note: Retail index funds and ETFs are widely available; stock-exchange tax applies to trades.

gold.note: Investment gold is VAT-exempt and freely bought.

insuranceRegulator.name: Financial Services and Markets Authority (FSMA); National Bank of Belgium (prudential)

insuranceComplaints.name: Ombudsman des Assurances / Ombudsman van de Verzekeringen

oldAgeAllowance.name: Guaranteed Income for Elderly Persons (GIEP / IGO / GRAPA)
